title: 表示数字的最少运算符
summary: 只使用若干个 x 和加减乘除运算且不加括号，构造 target，求最少运算符数量。
insight: 把 target 按 x 进制逐位处理；每位既可正向使用 digit 个 x^k，也可向高位借一后使用 x-digit 个负项，维护两种最小代价。
pitfalls: 最低位的 1 要写成 x/x，代价与高位幂不同
最终负状态还需补一个更高位 x^k
结果中的首项不需要前导加号，因此最后减一

solutions.title: x 进制进借位动态规划
solutions.idea: 逐位维护正表示与向高位借位表示的运算符代价。

code.java: class Solution { public int leastOpsExpressTarget(int x,int target){int positive=0,negative=0,k=0;while(target>0){int digit=target%x;target/=x;if(k==0){positive=2*digit;negative=2*(x-digit);}else{int nextPositive=Math.min(positive+digit*k,negative+(digit+1)*k);int nextNegative=Math.min(positive+(x-digit)*k,negative+(x-digit-1)*k);positive=nextPositive;negative=nextNegative;}k++;}return Math.min(positive,negative+k)-1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun leastOpsExpressTarget(x:Int,targetInput:Int):Int{var target=targetInput;var positive=0;var negative=0;var k=0;while(target>0){val digit=target%x;target/=x;if(k==0){positive=2*digit;negative=2*(x-digit)}else{val nextPositive=minOf(positive+digit*k,negative+(digit+1)*k);val nextNegative=minOf(positive+(x-digit)*k,negative+(x-digit-1)*k);positive=nextPositive;negative=nextNegative};k++};return minOf(positive,negative+k)-1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int leastOpsExpressTarget(int x,int target){int positive=0,negative=0,k=0;while(target>0){int digit=target%x;target/=x;if(k==0){positive=2*digit;negative=2*(x-digit);}else{int nextPositive=min(positive+digit*k,negative+(digit+1)*k);int nextNegative=min(positive+(x-digit)*k,negative+(x-digit-1)*k);positive=nextPositive;negative=nextNegative;}++k;}return min(positive,negative+k)-1;} };
